The yield strength of W-11Re-IThO2 at 2000 K was 185 MPa, about 75 MPa greater than the yield strength of W-1ThO 2 at the same temperature.
The yield strength of W-11Re-IThO2 at 2000 K was 185 MPa, about 75 MPa greater than the yield strength of W-1ThO 2 at the same temperature.
It is well known that the solid solution strengthening results from the interaction between solute atoms and dislocations.
One is the elastic interaction which arises from the mutual interaction of elastic stress field that surrounds the misfit solute atom and the edge dislocation core.
Another is the modulus interaction which occurs when the presence of the solute atom locally alters the modulus of the matrix.
the cross-slip of screw dislocations was the dominant deformation mechanism for the W-Re-1ThO2 alloys that were deformed at temperatures below 2000 K.
Grain boundary sliding, however, was found to be the dominant deformation mechanism in the W-Re-1ThO2 alloys when they were deformed at temperatures above 2000 K.
rhenium concentrations above l I wt.% in the thoriated tungsten resulted in a strength degradation instead of strengthening owing to rhenium-introduced structural instability
